verdict.rationale: Conductor's changelog announces 'routines', which let users run their agents on a schedule (or via GitHub Action). That is a first-party recurring-scheduling capability for agent workflows, not a one-off trigger, but the only evidence is a single changelog line. Missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration (cron syntax, frequency, time zones), management or monitoring of scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
